title: OS release and kernel
semantics: INFO: distro, version, kernel release.

title: Pending security updates
semantics: FAIL: >=1 pending security update in the package cache; WARN: non-security updates pending only; PASS: none. Reads cache only (apt-get -s / dnf -C), never refreshes.

title: Automatic security updates
semantics: PASS: unattended-upgrades / dnf-automatic enabled; WARN: not configured.

title: Reboot pending for updates
semantics: WARN: /var/run/reboot-required present (patched kernel/libs not loaded); PASS: absent.

title: Yama ptrace scope
semantics: WARN: kernel.yama.ptrace_scope=0; PASS: >=1; NA: Yama absent.

title: Kernel pointer restriction
semantics: WARN: kernel.kptr_restrict=0; PASS: >=1.

title: dmesg restriction
semantics: WARN: kernel.dmesg_restrict=0; PASS: 1.

title: Unprivileged eBPF
semantics: WARN: kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=0; PASS: 1 or 2.

title: Unprivileged user namespaces
semantics: WARN: unprivileged userns creation allowed (unprivileged_userns_clone=1 / max_user_namespaces>0) and not AppArmor-restricted; PASS: disabled or apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1.

title: ASLR
semantics: FAIL: kernel.randomize_va_space<2; PASS: 2.

title: setuid core dumps
semantics: WARN: fs.suid_dumpable!=0; PASS: 0.

title: Protected symlinks/hardlinks
semantics: WARN: fs.protected_symlinks or fs.protected_hardlinks =0; PASS: both 1.

title: perf_event paranoia
semantics: WARN: kernel.perf_event_paranoid<2; PASS: >=2.

title: IPv4 forwarding
semantics: WARN: net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 (host routes traffic; pivot aid); PASS: 0.

title: Mandatory access control
semantics: PASS: SELinux enforcing or AppArmor enabled; WARN: SELinux permissive/disabled and no AppArmor.

title: Host firewall
semantics: PASS: ufw/firewalld/nftables/iptables service active or ufw ENABLED=yes; WARN: none active; ERR: cannot determine.

title: SSH root login
semantics: FAIL: PermitRootLogin yes; PASS: no / prohibit-password / forced-commands-only / default; NA: no sshd_config.

title: SSH password authentication
semantics: WARN: PasswordAuthentication yes (explicit or default); PASS: no; NA: no sshd_config.

title: SSH empty passwords
semantics: FAIL: PermitEmptyPasswords yes; PASS: no/default; NA: no sshd_config.

title: SSH X11 forwarding
semantics: WARN: X11Forwarding yes; PASS: no/default; NA: no sshd_config.

title: SSH MaxAuthTries
semantics: WARN: MaxAuthTries >4 (default 6); PASS: <=4; NA: no sshd_config.

title: SSH weak ciphers/MACs/KEX
semantics: WARN: configured Ciphers/MACs/KexAlgorithms include cbc, arcfour, 3des, md5, sha1 KEX or group1; PASS: none configured weak (default set); NA: no sshd_config.

title: SSH host private key permissions
semantics: FAIL: an /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key is group/world readable or readable by the current non-root user; PASS: otherwise; NA: no host keys.

title: Extra UID 0 accounts
semantics: FAIL: any account other than root has UID 0; PASS: only root.

title: Accounts with empty password
semantics: FAIL: /etc/shadow has an empty password field; PASS: none; ERR: shadow not readable (needs root).

title: sudo NOPASSWD rules
semantics: WARN: >=1 NOPASSWD rule in sudoers/sudoers.d; PASS: none; ERR: sudoers unreadable (needs root); NA: sudo absent.

title: Administrative group members
semantics: INFO: members of sudo/wheel/admin groups.

title: Default umask
semantics: WARN: login.defs UMASK grants group/other write (e.g. 002, 000); PASS: 022/027/077.

title: Password maximum age
semantics: WARN: login.defs PASS_MAX_DAYS unset or >365; PASS: <=365.

title: /etc/shadow permissions
semantics: FAIL: /etc/shadow (or gshadow) world-readable or world-writable; PASS: otherwise.

title: /etc/passwd permissions
semantics: FAIL: /etc/passwd or /etc/group writable by group/other; PASS: otherwise.

title: /tmp mount options
semantics: WARN: /tmp not a separate mount, or mounted without nosuid/nodev; PASS: separate mount with nosuid,nodev.

title: /dev/shm mount options
semantics: WARN: /dev/shm mounted without noexec or nosuid; PASS: noexec,nosuid.

title: World-writable directories in PATH
semantics: FAIL: a directory on PATH (or /etc/environment PATH) is world-writable without sticky bit; PASS: none.

title: Cron configuration permissions
semantics: FAIL: /etc/crontab or an /etc/cron.* entry is world-writable; PASS: none.

title: Audit daemon
semantics: PASS: auditd active; WARN: not active.

title: System logging
semantics: PASS: rsyslog/syslog-ng active or journald persistent storage; WARN: only volatile journal.

title: Time synchronization
semantics: PASS: chronyd/systemd-timesyncd/ntpd active; WARN: none (breaks Kerberos and log correlation).

title: UEFI Secure Boot
semantics: PASS: Secure Boot enabled; WARN: UEFI with Secure Boot disabled; INFO: legacy BIOS boot.

title: Failed systemd units
semantics: INFO: count of failed units.

title: Docker socket exposure
semantics: FAIL: /var/run/docker.sock world-writable or writable by the current non-root user; PASS: present and restricted; NA: absent.

title: Directory membership
semantics: INFO: realm/sssd/winbind membership and realm name, or not joined.

title: Host keytab readability
semantics: FAIL: /etc/krb5.keytab readable by the current non-root user or world-readable; PASS: present and restricted; NA: absent.

title: OS edition and build
semantics: INFO: caption, build.UBR, product type (workstation/server/DC).

title: Last update age
semantics: FAIL: newest installed hotfix >90 days old; WARN: 45-90 days; PASS: <45; ERR: no hotfix dates readable.

title: Firewall - Domain profile
semantics: PASS: profile enabled (policy or local); WARN: disabled.

title: Firewall - Private profile
semantics: PASS: profile enabled; WARN: disabled.

title: Firewall - Public profile
semantics: PASS: profile enabled; FAIL: disabled.

title: Defender real-time protection
semantics: PASS: real-time protection on; FAIL: off; NA: Defender not present (third-party AV).

title: Defender tamper protection
semantics: PASS: tamper protection on; WARN: off; NA: Defender not present.

title: Defender signature age
semantics: WARN: AV signatures >7 days old; PASS: <=7; NA: Defender not present.

title: BitLocker on system drive
semantics: PASS: system drive protection on; WARN: off; ERR: not readable without elevation.

title: UEFI Secure Boot
semantics: PASS: UEFISecureBootEnabled=1; WARN: 0; INFO: legacy BIOS / state key absent.

title: SMBv1 server
semantics: FAIL: SMB1 server enabled (LanmanServer SMB1=1 or mrxsmb10 driver enabled); PASS: disabled/absent.

title: SMB server signing required
semantics: FAIL: LanmanServer RequireSecuritySignature!=1 (relay target); PASS: 1.

title: SMB client signing required
semantics: WARN: LanmanWorkstation RequireSecuritySignature!=1; PASS: 1.

title: LLMNR
semantics: FAIL: LLMNR not disabled by policy (DNSClient EnableMulticast!=0); PASS: 0.

title: NetBIOS over TCP/IP
semantics: WARN: >=1 IP-enabled adapter with NetBIOS not disabled (NetbiosOptions!=2); PASS: all disabled.

title: WPAD auto-proxy discovery
semantics: WARN: WinHttpAutoProxySvc enabled and WPAD not disabled; PASS: service disabled or DisableWpad=1.

title: LDAP client signing
semantics: PASS: LDAPClientIntegrity=2 (require); WARN: 0 (none) or 1 (negotiate, default).

title: Anonymous enumeration restrictions
semantics: WARN: RestrictAnonymousSAM=0 or RestrictAnonymous=0 with EveryoneIncludesAnonymous=1; PASS: restricted.

title: PowerShell v2 engine
semantics: WARN: PowerShell 2.0 engine installed (downgrade bypasses logging); PASS: absent.

title: PowerShell script-block logging
semantics: PASS: EnableScriptBlockLogging=1 by policy; WARN: not enabled.

title: PowerShell transcription
semantics: PASS: EnableTranscripting=1 by policy; WARN: not enabled.

title: PowerShell language mode
semantics: INFO: current session language mode (FullLanguage / ConstrainedLanguage).

title: Remote Desktop
semantics: INFO: RDP enabled (fDenyTSConnections=0) or disabled.

title: RDP Network Level Authentication
semantics: FAIL: RDP enabled and UserAuthentication!=1; PASS: NLA required; NA: RDP disabled.

title: LSA protection (RunAsPPL)
semantics: PASS: Lsa RunAsPPL 1 or 2; WARN: not set.

title: Credential Guard
semantics: PASS: Credential Guard running; WARN: not running; ERR: DeviceGuard WMI unavailable.

title: WDigest cleartext credentials
semantics: FAIL: WDigest UseLogonCredential=1 (cleartext passwords in LSASS); PASS: 0/absent on 8.1+.

title: LAN Manager authentication level
semantics: FAIL: LmCompatibilityLevel<3 (LM/NTLMv1 sent); WARN: 3-4 or unset; PASS: 5.

title: LM hash storage
semantics: FAIL: NoLMHash=0; PASS: 1/default.

title: Cached domain logons
semantics: WARN: CachedLogonsCount >4 (default 10); PASS: <=4; NA: not domain-joined.

title: UAC enabled
semantics: FAIL: EnableLUA=0; PASS: 1.

title: UAC admin consent prompt
semantics: WARN: ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=0 (elevate without prompting); PASS: otherwise.

title: LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy
semantics: WARN: LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy=1 (full admin token for remote local-account logons; pass-the-hash); PASS: 0/absent.

title: AlwaysInstallElevated
semantics: FAIL: AlwaysInstallElevated=1 in both HKLM and HKCU; PASS: otherwise.

title: Local Administrators members
semantics: INFO: member count and names of the local Administrators group.

title: Guest account
semantics: FAIL: built-in Guest enabled; PASS: disabled.

title: AutoLogon stored password
semantics: FAIL: Winlogon DefaultPassword present; WARN: AutoAdminLogon=1 without stored password; PASS: neither. Never prints the value.

title: LAPS client policy
semantics: PASS: Windows LAPS or legacy AdmPwd policy enabled; WARN: no LAPS policy; NA: not domain-joined.

title: Print Spooler
semantics: WARN: Spooler running on a domain controller (coercion/PrintNightmare surface); INFO: running on a non-DC; PASS: stopped/disabled.

title: WinRM transport
semantics: FAIL: WinRM AllowUnencrypted=1; WARN: HTTP listener with no HTTPS listener; PASS: HTTPS or HTTP with encryption enforced; NA: WinRM not running.

title: Domain membership
semantics: INFO: domain name and role (workgroup / member / DC).

title: Domain minimum password length
semantics: FAIL: minPwdLength<8; WARN: 8-13; PASS: >=14.

title: Domain account lockout threshold
semantics: FAIL: lockoutThreshold=0 (unlimited guessing); WARN: >10; PASS: 1-10.

title: Domain maximum password age
semantics: INFO: maxPwdAge in days (0 = never expires).

title: krbtgt password age
semantics: FAIL: krbtgt pwdLastSet >365 days; WARN: 180-365; PASS: <180.

title: Kerberoastable user accounts
semantics: FAIL: >=1 enabled user (not computer) with an SPN; PASS: 0.

title: AS-REP roastable accounts
semantics: FAIL: >=1 enabled account with DONT_REQ_PREAUTH; PASS: 0.

title: Unconstrained delegation (non-DC)
semantics: FAIL: >=1 enabled non-DC computer or user with TRUSTED_FOR_DELEGATION; PASS: 0.

title: adminCount=1 users
semantics: INFO: count of users with adminCount=1.

title: Domain Admins membership
semantics: WARN: >5 distinct (recursive) members; INFO: count otherwise.

title: Protected Users group
semantics: WARN: Protected Users has no members; PASS: >=1.

title: Machine account quota
semantics: WARN: ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota>0 (any user can join computers; RBCD/Certifried aid); PASS: 0.

title: Domain/forest functional level
semantics: WARN: domain functional level below 2016 (msDS-Behavior-Version<7); PASS: >=7.

title: DC LDAP signing / channel binding
semantics: FAIL: DC LDAPServerIntegrity<2 where remotely readable; PASS: 2; NA: not remotely readable (never a false PASS).

title: Domain trusts
semantics: INFO: count and direction of trustedDomain objects.

title: LAPS schema present
semantics: PASS: ms-Mcs-AdmPwd or msLAPS-Password attribute in schema; WARN: neither.
